answer_1.quote: Experiments on two text generation tasks, including positive-sentiment and detoxified text continuation, and debiased text summarization, demonstrate the advantages of our method in aligning LLMs to generated less biased outputs.

answer_2.quote: In addition, we follow Ramamurthy et al. ( ) and to measure fluency with perplexity for text continuation and lexical and semantic performance with ROUGE-L and BERTScore-Precision for text summarization. Commonly adopted diversity metrics of Distinct are also reported.
